decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall be used only for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the occupier of 70 Firs Drive and for no other purpose including the provision of living accommodation or for any business use.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south east and north west side facing elevations of the outbuilding hereby approval, without prior written consent from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding as a playroom to the rear garden of the house.
